documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our managed services team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's operational friction is their lack of clarity on specific requirements and project ownership, as stated: 'We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner.' This is preventing them from moving forward with a discovery meeting or evaluating Cedar Systems' solutions effectively.

claims.quote: We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. It sounds like your managed services team is currently exploring options, but you haven't yet identified a specific requirement or project owner. To help move forward, could you clarify what specific workflows or integration needs you're currently evaluating? This will allow us to better align with your goals and schedule a discovery meeting that addresses your priorities.
questions: What specific workflows or integration needs are you currently evaluating?
Who would be the project owner or primary decision-maker for this initiative?
uncertainties: The lack of clarity on specific requirements or project ownership is preventing further action.
